SUB001.title: Fixed code/config after readiness
SUB001.rewrite: Accept SEAL001/004/005/008/009; run seal-check with the app suite. Restart to change code/config.
SUB001.removes: Entry/body/epoch revalidation; does not certify mutable receivers or data.

SUB002.title: Finite dispatch
SUB002.rewrite: Replace computed send/eval with explicit branches or a finite literal dispatch table.

SUB003.title: Finite callback chain
SUB003.rewrite: Keep security callbacks; extract Proc/around callbacks into named, explicitly ordered before/after methods for this prototype.
SUB003.removes: Callback interpreter only, never callback bodies or authorization.

SUB004.title: Explicit template inputs
SUB004.rewrite: Declare strict locals (including locals: () for no locals); pass partial inputs explicitly.
SUB004.removes: SEAL007 and repeated locals-shape/template lookup certification.

SUB005.title: No helper/template assign mutation
SUB005.rewrite: Compute assigns in the controller; return helper values or use explicit content_for instead of mutating view ivars.
SUB005.removes: Mid-render assign effects that invalidated handwritten endpoint ceilings.

SUB006.title: Finite synchronous render graph
SUB006.rewrite: Name each partial/layout explicitly; keep cache, streaming, components and unknown renderers on stock Rails until supported.
SUB006.removes: Resolver/handler/collection dispatch; cached rendering is NOT disabled.

SUB007.title: Static AR query structure
SUB007.rewrite: Use named scopes with bound values and fixed table/association names; retain real AR callbacks, casts and queries.
SUB007.removes: Query-shape/reflection guards only; does not license direct ivar reads or SQL/result caching.

SUB008.title: Closed source boundary
SUB008.rewrite: Supply boot facts and source for generated/inherited targets; certify helper/gem effects separately or leave the call live.
SUB008.removes: Unknown method/type/effect boundaries; observed types alone are not proof.
